main_text.l: Abiatharum deposuit. Et Cl. Walæus p. 178. Quis unquam negavit propter notoria delicta, quæ simpliciter civi-

l.i: lia sunt, speciatim ob proditionem contra
Pastorem posse neci dari, aut exilio
quidem omnia judicia Ecclesiastica in eo
mò degradandi essent à suis spiritualibus,
clesiâ ab officio posse Magistratum extra
ordinem procurare, ut Ecclesia redeat ad

main_text.l: dinaria adhiberi remedia &c. Quam sententiam Junii laudat Bogermannus.

page.notes: The large initial "Q" of "Quis" is a decorative capital and is joined to the word. The running head begins with a section sign, which I read as "§" with a doubt, hence [?]. The italic/roman boundaries are read from the scan and may be slightly off at the word level. No printing errors or illegible words were found.
